standard_prerequisites.name: The description of specializations through closed subsets of the target and their preimages
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof (source lines 3900-3912)
standard_prerequisites.use: Reformulates the lifting condition as a statement about the section and closedness.

core_obligations: Reformulate: a specialization in the target with the upper point in the image corresponds to a closed subset of the target containing the lower point, and lifting amounts to finding a preimage of the upper point inside the preimage of that closed subset (proof lines 3899-3912)

Use the section: composing the section of the map with the given point produces a candidate lift, and closedness of the map together with its surjectivity places it in the required preimage (proof lines 3913-3929)
proof_roadmap: 把 y' ⇝ y 写成「y 属于含 y' 的闭集 F」，提升等价于在 f^{-1}(F) 中找 y' 的原像。
由截面 s 与闭性/满性，s(y') 的相应像落在所需的 f^{-1}(F) 中，即得提升。
